title: MCEarth
description: 1:200 Earth Map with Towny plugin, MCMMO, KOTH, Custom Head Crates, Custom Badges & MORE!
body:
**Build nations. Control territory. Shape the world.**

MinecraftEarth is a **geopolitical Towny survival server** set on a **1:200 scale map of Earth**.  
Claim real-world locations, build powerful towns, form alliances, and compete with other nations for global influence.

Whether you want to become a **merchant, leader, builder, or warrior**, MinecraftEarth offers a deep survival experience driven by its community.

---

---

##  Explore the World

The server runs on a **massive Earth map** recreated at **1:200 scale**.

Build your town in real-world locations like:

- 🇬🇧 London  
- 🇯🇵 Tokyo  
- 🇺🇸 New York  
- 🇩🇪 Berlin  
- 🇧🇷 Rio  

Or create your own civilization anywhere across the globe.

---

##  Core Gameplay

###  Towns & Nations
Create a town, recruit players, expand territory, and build powerful nations.

###  Player Economy
Trade resources, open player shops, and grow your wealth in a dynamic economy.

###  MCMMO Skills
Level up skills like mining, combat, woodcutting, and farming to improve your abilities.

###  PvP & Events
Compete in **server events, wars, and King of the Hill battles** for rewards and prestige.

###  Crates & Rewards
Unlock cosmetics, keys, and unique rewards through gameplay and events.

---

##  Community

MinecraftEarth focuses on a **community-driven geopolitical experience**.

Players regularly:

- Form alliances  
- Build large cities  
- Run player markets  
- Compete in events  
- Create global conflicts and diplomacy

Every decision can shape the world.

---

##  Join Today

Start your journey and build your empire.
